title: CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified
chineseTitle: 第 9 章：雷切尔·林德太太惊呆了

paragraphs.en: Anne had spent two weeks at Green Gables before Mrs. Lynde arrived for an inspection. Despite her usual good health, Mrs. Rachel was confined to her house due to grippe, which she considered a special visitation from Providence. Once allowed outside by her doctor, she eagerly made the journey to see Matthew and Marilla's orphan.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在雷切尔·林德夫人到来检查之前已经在绿山墙度过了两个星期。尽管她通常身体很好，但雷切尔夫人因患了流行性感冒而不得不卧床在家，她认为这是天意的特别眷顾。医生允许她外出后，她迫不及待地前往埃文利，去看望马修和玛丽拉收养的孩子。

paragraphs.en: During those two weeks, Anne explored every corner of Green Gables. She discovered a lane leading through an apple orchard and into woodland, where she wandered along brooks and bridges, through fir coppices and wild cherry arches, and among ferns and maples.
paragraphs.zh: 在这两个星期里，安妮探索了绿山墙的每一个角落。她发现了一条小径，穿过苹果园和树林，沿着溪流和小桥漫步，在云杉丛生的小片林地、野生樱桃树形成的拱门间穿行，还徜徉在蕨类植物和枫树之间。

paragraphs.en: Anne befriended the spring in the hollow—a deep, clear, icy-cold water source surrounded by red sandstones and palm-like water ferns. Beyond it lay a log bridge over a stream.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮与那片洼地里的春水成了好朋友——这是一处清澈冰冷的水源，四周被红色砂岩环绕，水边长着类似棕榈叶的水蕨。越过这片水域是一座木桥，架在一条小溪上。

paragraphs.en: Crossing this bridge led Anne to a wooded hill where perpetual twilight reigned under thick firs and spruces. Here, she found delicate "June bells" and pale starflowers among the trees. The air was filled with gossamer threads that seemed to whisper friendly words.
paragraphs.zh: 穿过这座桥，安妮来到了一片林木繁茂的山丘，在这里，浓密的冷杉和云杉之下终年弥漫着一抹幽暗的暮光。她发现树间点缀着娇嫩的“六月铃铛花”和淡雅的星花。空气中弥漫着如丝般的细纱，仿佛在轻声低语，传递着友好的话语。

paragraphs.en: These adventures took place in the few half-hours Anne had for play. She shared her discoveries with Matthew and Marilla, who listened with a smile. Marilla would occasionally cut off Anne's chatter with a curt command to be quiet.
paragraphs.zh: 这些冒险发生在安妮仅有的一点玩耍时间里。她把这些发现与马修和玛丽拉分享，两人微笑着听她说。偶尔，玛丽拉会用简短而生硬的命令打断安妮的絮叨，让她安静下来。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel Lynde visited Marilla and Matthew in the orchard, where Anne was enjoying herself among the vibrant grasses bathed in evening light. Mrs. Rachel began by discussing Anne's health, describing her ailments with evident pleasure, much to Marilla’s surprise.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德太太在果园里拜访了玛丽拉和马修，当时安妮正享受着傍晚阳光下生机勃勃的草地。雷切尔太太首先谈起了安妮的身体状况，详细描述着她的病痛，显然乐此不疲，这让玛丽拉感到十分意外。

paragraphs.en: "Matthew took a liking to her," said Marilla, "and I like her too, despite her faults."
paragraphs.zh: “马修挺喜欢她，”玛丽拉说，“尽管她有些缺点，我也不讨厌她。”

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel then revealed why she had come: "I heard some surprising things about you and Matthew." Marilla responded, "I'm not surprised anymore; I’m getting used to it now."
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔太太随后道出了她来访的原因：“我听说了一些关于你和马修的惊人事情。”玛丽拉回答说：“我已经不再感到惊讶了；我现在已经习惯了。”

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel sympathetically added, "It was a mistake, but couldn't you have sent her back?"
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔太太同情地补充道：“这确实是个误会，但你不能把她送回去吗？”

paragraphs.en: "We decided against it," said Marilla. "The house feels different with her here. She’s bright and lively."
paragraphs.zh: “我们决定不那么做了，”玛丽拉说，“自从她来了，这房子感觉不一样了。她活泼开朗。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla's expression showed disapproval, prompting Mrs. Rachel to say, "You’ve taken on a great responsibility without experience. I don’t want to discourage you."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉的表情流露出不赞成，这让雷切尔太太说道：“你毫无经验却承担了这么大的责任。我不希望你因此而灰心。”

paragraphs.en: "Let me see Anne," requested Mrs. Rachel. Marilla called for Anne, who entered the room with a radiant face from her orchard adventure.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔太太说道：“让我看看安妮。”玛丽拉叫来了安妮，只见她从苹果园回来，脸上洋溢着喜悦的光芒。

paragraphs.en: Finding herself in the presence of a stranger, Anne hesitated at the door. Her short, tight wincey dress made her appear oddly proportioned, and her freckles were more prominent than ever. Mrs. Rachel commented, "She’s skinny and plain.
paragraphs.zh: 发现自己面对陌生人，安妮站在门口犹豫不决。她那短小紧身的棉布裙子让她显得身形有些比例失调，而她的雀斑比以往更加明显。雷切尔太太评论道：“她瘦骨嶙峋，相貌平平。”

paragraphs.en: Come here, child, let me see you."
paragraphs.zh: 来这儿，孩子，让我看看你。

paragraphs.en: Anne approached, and Mrs. Rachel continued, "Did anyone ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots!"
paragraphs.zh: 安妮走近，雷切尔太太接着说道：“见过这么满脸雀斑的没？还有红得像胡萝卜一样的头发！”

paragraphs.en: Anne burst into the kitchen with a fury that left Mrs. Rachel speechless. Her face was flushed, and she stood trembling from head to toe.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮怒气冲冲地闯进厨房，把雷切尔太太的话都说不出口了。她的脸涨得通红，浑身上下都在颤抖。

paragraphs.en: "I hate you," Anne cried, stamping her foot. "How dare you call me skinny and ugly? How could you say I'm freckled and redheaded?"
paragraphs.zh: “我恨你，”安妮喊道，跺着脚。“你怎么敢说我瘦骨嶙峋、其貌不扬？你怎么能说我是雀斑红头发？”

paragraphs.en: Marilla tried to intervene but Anne continued, her eyes blazing with anger.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉试图干预，但安妮继续说着，眼中怒火中烧。

paragraphs.en: "How would you like such things said about you?" she demanded. "You are a rude, unfeeling woman!"
paragraphs.zh: “如果你听到别人这样说起你，你会作何感想？”她问道，“你真是粗鲁无情的女人！”

paragraphs.en: Anne's sobs grew louder as she fled to her room, slamming the door so hard that the tins on the porch wall rattled.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的抽泣声越来越大，她飞奔回自己的房间，用力一甩门，连前廊墙上的锡罐都震得直响。

paragraphs.en: "Well, I don't envy you your job," Mrs. Rachel remarked solemnly.
paragraphs.zh: “我可不会羡慕你这份差事，”雷切尔太太庄重地说。

paragraphs.en: Marilla responded, “You shouldn’t have teased her about her appearance.”
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉回答说：“你不该取笑她的Appearance。”

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel was taken aback. "Are you defending such a display of temper?"
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔太太显然吃了一惊：“你竟为这种暴躁的行为辩护？”

paragraphs.en: "No," Marilla said slowly. "She’s been very naughty and needs a talking-to. But we must understand her.
paragraphs.zh: “不，”玛丽拉缓缓说道，“她确实很淘气，需要好好谈一谈。但我们必须试着理解她。”

paragraphs.en: She's never learned what is right, and you were too harsh on her."
paragraphs.zh: 她从来不知道什么是正确，你对她太严厉了。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel Lynde left with an air of offended dignity after Marilla's comment about Anne's feelings. "I'll have to be careful what I say now," Marilla thought, feeling surprised at herself.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德太太带着一脸受了侮辱的端庄离开了，听到玛丽拉对安妮心情的看法后。玛丽拉心想：“以后我得多加小心我的言语了。”她对自己竟然有这样的反应感到惊讶。

paragraphs.en: "Anne," Marilla said sternly, finding her crying bitterly on the bed. Anne sat rigidly on a chair beside it, her face swollen and tear-stained.
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，”玛丽拉严厉地说，看到她在床上哭泣得如此伤心。安妮僵硬地坐在床边的一把椅子上，脸肿胀且泪痕斑斑。

paragraphs.en: Marilla decided against using a birch switch, as suggested by Mrs. Rachel. She felt she couldn't discipline Anne that way. Instead, she needed to find another method to teach Anne about her behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉决定不采用雷切尔太太建议的柳条枝惩罚方式，因为她觉得用这种方式管教安妮不合适。她需要找到另一种方法来教育安妮关于她的行为规范。

paragraphs.en: Anne's outburst in front of Mrs. Rachel Lynde worried Marilla greatly. How unfortunate! Marilla felt more humiliation than sorrow over the incident and pondered how to handle it.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在雷切尔·林德太太面前的爆发让玛丽拉非常担忧。真是不幸！玛丽拉感到更多的是羞愧而非悲伤，她思索着该如何应对这一局面。

paragraphs.en: Anne was reprimanded for her outburst towards Mrs. Lynde.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮因对雷切尔·林德太太的爆发而受到了训斥。

paragraphs.en: "Anne, this is no way to behave," Marilla began sternly. "You shouldn't have called her ugly and redheaded."
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，你这样行为不当，”玛丽拉严肃地说，“你不应该叫她又丑又红头发。”

paragraphs.en: "I didn't call her that; she did," Anne defended herself, evading the accusation.
paragraphs.zh: “我没有那样叫她，是她自己这么说的，”安妮为自己辩护，避开了责备。

paragraphs.en: "You lost your temper and talked rudely to her," Marilla continued. "I was ashamed of you. I wanted you to be polite to Mrs. Lynde, but instead, you disgraced me."
paragraphs.zh: “你失了态，对她出言不逊，”玛丽拉继续说道，“我为你感到羞愧。我想让你对雷切尔·林德女士礼貌一些，结果反而让我丢了脸。”

paragraphs.en: Anne cried, "But it's different when someone else says it! You know something is true, but you can't help hoping others don't think so."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮哭道：“可别人这么说就不同了！你知道事情的真相，但总忍不住希望别人不要这么想。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla recalled a childhood memory: an aunt had once called her dark and homely. The sting of that memory lingered.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉回想起童年的记忆：有一次，一位姑妈曾直言她又黑又丑。那种刺痛的感觉至今犹存。

paragraphs.en: "Mrs. Lynde may have been too direct," Marilla admitted softly. "But that's no excuse for your behavior. She was a stranger, elderly, and my guest—reasons to be respectful."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉轻声承认：“雷切尔·林德太太或许太过直率了，”但她随即说道，“但这不能成为你行为不当的理由。她是个陌生人，年纪又大，还是我的客人——这些都是我们应该尊重她的理由。”

paragraphs.en: Anne stubbornly declared, "I can't apologize to Mrs. Lynde. You can punish me any way you like, but I won't ask her forgiveness."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮坚决地说：“我不会向雷切尔·林德太太道歉。你们尽管惩罚我，但我绝不会求她的原谅。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla said sternly that they didn't lock people up in dark dungeons, especially since such places were rare in Avonlea. Anne must apologize to Mrs. Lynde and stay in her room until she agreed.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉严肃地说，他们可不会把人关进黑暗的地牢里，尤其是在埃文利这种地方这样的地方极为罕见。安妮必须向雷切尔·林德夫人道歉，并且待在自己的房间里，直到她同意为止。

paragraphs.en: Anne replied sadly, "I'll have to stay forever because I can’t say sorry to Mrs. Lynde. I’m not sorry for what I said; I'm only sorry I upset you. It was a relief to tell the truth."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮悲伤地回答：“我得永远留下，因为我不敢向雷切尔·林德夫人道歉。我不是为自己说过的话感到抱歉；我只是为让你难过而感到遗憾。说实话是一种解脱。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla left, saying Anne had time to think and change her mind by morning.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉离开了，说安妮还有时间思考并改变主意，等到明天再说。

paragraphs.en: In the kitchen, Marilla felt troubled. She was as angry with herself as with Anne, remembering Mrs. Rachel's shocked face made her want to laugh.
paragraphs.zh: 在厨房里，玛丽拉感到有些不安。她对自己和安妮都感到愤怒，想起雷切尔太太震惊的脸庞，不禁想笑出来。
